title: Staging laparoscopy in locally advanced gastric adenocarcinoma: diagnostic yield, predictors of occult metastatic disease, and development of a clinical prediction score.
snippet: Computed tomography (CT) fails to detect occult peritoneal and distant metastases in a significant minority of patients with locally advanced gastric cancer (LAGC).
